name: World Rules
description: Rules for each world: mobs breaking blocks, blasts destroying items, keeping your inventory on death, sleeping in beds, the weather, natural monsters, monster light, apples from oak leaves, the falling hit bonus, bows that wear out. They run where the world runs, so a server can use them with any client. Worlds you already have stay as they are.
authors: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic's AI), at Studio Quire
